timing.backend_order: Shuffle case keys separately within each panel with random.Random(20261028); alternate R-first and prusie-first after shuffling.
timing.fresh_process: One process per case/backend; backends run sequentially within each case.
timing.complete_call: Complete public susie_rss call; input reads, gc and export are outside the clock.
timing.fitting: Optional directly timed same-call spans using the archived native patch and R helper; no subtraction of separately measured costs.
timing.headline: Sum of all retained R times divided by the corresponding prusie total for the evaluated cases.

fit.parameters: Read exactly from each frozen case JSON; no filtering or parameter changes.

historical_repeat_policy: 24 completed cases retained warmup and first three times from an earlier seven-retained-call protocol; saved alpha arrays are from repeat seven. All other complete cases use one warmup plus three retained calls.

alpha_comparison.component_order: Original rows; no permutation or filtering
alpha_comparison.reported_metric: Maximum absolute difference over the complete final alpha matrix.

timing_instrumentation: The manuscript measured an instrumented derivative of the frozen wheel. The default portable mode uses the original wheel and records complete-call time only; instrumented mode requires rebuilding from the exact archived patch.
